# joineRML 0.4.9 ![joineRML hex logo](reference/figures/hex.png)

**joineRML** fits joint models for multiple continuous longitudinal
outcomes and a time-to-event outcome. It combines multivariate linear
mixed-effects models with a Cox proportional hazards model, estimated
using Monte Carlo EM. The package also provides dynamic predictions,
bootstrap inference, and model summaries in tidy tables.

## Installation

joineRML requires R 4.1.0 or later.

### CRAN release

Install the current CRAN release with:

``` r

install.packages("joineRML")
```

### Development version

Version 0.4.9 is being prepared for submission to CRAN. Install the
development version from GitHub with:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("graemeleehickey/joineRML")
```

Installation from GitHub requires a C++ compiler. On Windows, install
[Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) for your
version of R. On macOS, install the Xcode Command Line Tools by running
`xcode-select --install` in Terminal.

## Example

Use
[`mjoint()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/mjoint.md)
to fit a joint model. This example models two longitudinal outcomes, log
valve gradient and log left ventricular mass index, together with time
to death in the `heart.valve` dataset. For this illustration, we retain
visits with both longitudinal measurements observed.

``` r

library(joineRML)
data(heart.valve)
hvd <- heart.valve[!is.na(heart.valve$log.grad) & !is.na(heart.valve$log.lvmi), ]

set.seed(12345)
fit <- mjoint(
  formLongFixed = list(
    grad = log.grad ~ time + sex + hs,
    lvmi = log.lvmi ~ time + sex
  ),
  formLongRandom = list(
    grad = ~ 1 | num,
    lvmi = ~ time | num
  ),
  formSurv = Surv(fuyrs, status) ~ age,
  data = list(hvd, hvd),
  timeVar = "time"
)
```

Inspect the estimates, obtain a tidy table with confidence intervals,
and plot the convergence history of the survival-model parameters:

``` r

summary(fit)
tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)
plot(fit, params = "gamma")
```

joineRML supplies the broom-compatible methods
[`tidy()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/tidy.html),
[`augment()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/augment.html), and
[`glance()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/glance.html).
Approximate standard errors are calculated from the empirical
information matrix; use
[`bootSE()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/bootSE.md)
for bootstrap standard errors and confidence intervals. The functions
[`dynLong()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/dynLong.md)
and
[`dynSurv()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/dynSurv.md)
provide subject-specific dynamic predictions for longitudinal outcomes
and survival, respectively.

From version 0.4.9, you can pass `seed = 12345` directly to
[`mjoint()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/mjoint.md)
instead of calling [`set.seed()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html)
before the fit. A supplied seed applies to that fit and preserves the
previous R random-number state.

Use `anova(fit_reduced, fit_full)` to compare nested covariate models
fitted to the same observations with the same random-effects structure.
The [model-comparison
help](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/anova.mjoint.html)
explains the likelihood-ratio test and its numerical-precision checks.
Use `test = FALSE` for a comparison table without a test.

## Documentation

The [package website](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/)
includes:

- An [introductory
  vignette](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/articles/joineRML.html)
  with worked examples.
- A [guide to tidy model
  summaries](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/articles/joineRML-tidy.html).
- A [technical
  vignette](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/technical.pdf)
  describing the model and estimation method.
- The complete [function
  reference](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/index.html).

For an installed CRAN package, you can also open the vignettes from R:

``` r

vignette("joineRML", package = "joineRML")
vignette("joineRML-tidy", package = "joineRML")
vignette("technical", package = "joineRML")
```

## Citation

If you use joineRML in a publication, please cite:

Hickey GL, Philipson P, Jorgensen A, Kolamunnage-Dona R. joineRML: a
joint model and software package for time-to-event and multivariate
longitudinal outcomes. *BMC Medical Research Methodology*. 2018; **18**:
50.
[doi:10.1186/s12874-018-0502-1](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12874-018-0502-1).

To obtain the citation and a BibTeX entry in R, run:

``` r

citation("joineRML")
```

## Support

Report bugs or suggest improvements through [GitHub
issues](https://github.com/graemeleehickey/joineRML/issues), or contact
the maintainer, [Graeme L. Hickey](mailto:graemeleehickey@gmail.com).

Development of joineRML was funded by the Medical Research Council
(grant MR/M013227/1).

# Package index

## Model fitting

- [`mjoint()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/mjoint.md)
  : Fit a joint model to time-to-event data and multivariate
  longitudinal data

- [`mjoint.object`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/mjoint.object.md)
  :

  Fitted `mjoint` object

- [`joineRML-package`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/joineRML-package.md)
  : joineRML: Joint Modelling of Multivariate Longitudinal Data and
  Time-to-Event Outcomes

- [`joineRML`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/joineRML.md)
  : joineRML

## Model summaries and inference

- [`anova(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/anova.mjoint.md)
  : Compare fitted joint models

- [`summary(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/summary.mjoint.md)
  :

  Summary of an `mjoint` object

- [`fixef(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/fixef.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract fixed effects estimates from an `mjoint` object

- [`ranef(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/ranef.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract random effects estimates from an `mjoint` object

- [`vcov(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/vcov.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract an approximate variance-covariance matrix of estimated
  parameters from an `mjoint` object

- [`confint(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/confint.mjoint.md)
  :

  Confidence intervals for model parameters of an `mjoint` object

- [`getVarCov(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/getVarCov.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract variance-covariance matrix of random effects from an `mjoint`
  object

- [`sigma(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/sigma.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract residual standard deviation(s) from an `mjoint` object

- [`logLik(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/logLik.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract log-likelihood from an `mjoint` object

- [`formula(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/formula.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract model formulae from an `mjoint` object

## Prediction and dynamic prediction

- [`fitted(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/fitted.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract `mjoint` fitted values

- [`residuals(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/residuals.mjoint.md)
  :

  Extract `mjoint` residuals

- [`dynSurv()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/dynSurv.md)
  : Dynamic predictions for the time-to-event data sub-model

- [`dynLong()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/dynLong.md)
  : Dynamic predictions for the longitudinal data sub-model

- [`baseHaz()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/baseHaz.md)
  :

  The baseline hazard estimate of an `mjoint` object

## Plotting and diagnostics

- [`plot(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/plot.mjoint.md)
  :

  Plot diagnostics from an `mjoint` object

- [`plot(`*`<ranef.mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/plot.ranef.mjoint.md)
  :

  Plot a `ranef.mjoint` object

- [`plot(`*`<dynSurv>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/plot.dynSurv.md)
  :

  Plot a `dynSurv` object

- [`plot(`*`<dynLong>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/plot.dynLong.md)
  :

  Plot a `dynLong` object

- [`plotConvergence()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/plotConvergence.md)
  :

  Plot convergence time series for parameter vectors from an `mjoint`
  object

## Simulation, resampling, and uncertainty

- [`simData()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/simData.md)
  : Simulate data from a joint model

- [`sampleData()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/sampleData.md)
  :

  Sample from an `mjoint` object

- [`bootSE()`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/bootSE.md)
  :

  Standard errors via bootstrap for an `mjoint` object

- [`tidy(`*`<mjoint>`*`)`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/mjoint_tidiers.md)

- [`reexports`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/reexports.md)
  [`augment`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/reexports.md)

  : Objects exported from other packages

## Data

- [`heart.valve`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/heart.valve.md)
  : Aortic valve replacement surgery data
- [`epileptic.qol`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/epileptic.qol.md)
  : Quality of life data following epilepsy drug treatment
- [`pbc2`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/pbc2.md)
  : Mayo Clinic primary biliary cirrhosis data
- [`renal`](https://graemeleehickey.github.io/joineRML/reference/renal.md)
  : Renal transplantation data
